verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software product or platform, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no shipped developer API that would make the axis apply: its mention of internal AI tools and a blockchain-based trading platform describes how it delivers services, not a public API. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404.
